description: Add a to-do note to your Canvas planner, e.g. "Email Prof. Lee about the extension". It shows on your Canvas To Do list and calendar. Only you see it.

course_id.description: Optional course to file it under (numeric ID from list_courses).

title.description: What to do, e.g. "Start the lab report".

todo_date.description: When, as an ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. "2026-11-07" or "2026-11-07T18:00:00".

name: create_planner_note
title: Create Planner Note
